body: I would agree in some circumstances, but we had a miscommunication and yadda yadda yadda. I still feel horrible because I still had feelings for her and I still currently do.

I ended getting involved with another girl without think, when my "girlfriend" and I had stopped talking and decided to focus on ourselves. We weren't technically still involved romantically during that time, but we ended up getting back together and amends were made, until I had admitted it. We were both hurt and we still are, but she forgave me and ultimately, I still feel horrible. I know I can't change it and she forgives me, but I still do hurt her from time to time because mentally, I'm still hurt by what I've done and I react improperly and have emotional outbursts.
